comparison.objective: Commission a shock absorber versus load an IV administration set into a pump module.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires rigid small-tool alignment and rotary adjustment; record routes tubing, seats an upper fitment, and presses a safety clamp into keyed recesses without pinching or misrouting the line.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two qualified impacts and a drift-resistant lock; record requires the specified fitment-first sequence, tubing correctly routed, safety clamp home, and door/module state valid.
comparison.reason: Keyed medical-set loading and tube routing test different contact and sequencing abilities from damper tuning. Candidate rebound, overload, and drift limits are undeclared.
